run_train_racecar: run the main function to train a racecar agent using DeepQ learning and save the model
review_callback: review the callback function that stops training when episode rewards exceed a threshold
build_racecar_env: build a RacecarGymEnv with discrete actions and no rendering for training
create_deepq_model: create a multi-layer perceptron model with 64 hidden units for the racecar agent
test_deepq_learn: test the deepq.learn function with custom hyperparameters like learning rate and buffer size
